grammar: 用 How old are you? 詢問年齡，用 How many...? 詢問數量
intro_zh: 在生活中，我們經常需要說出數字和數量。這一課將學習十一到一百萬的英文數字表達方式。你將學會用英文說出年齡、詢問物品的數量，並能理解日常生活中出現的各種數字。
can_do: 能用英文說出 11～100 和更大的數字
能用 How old are you? 詢問並回答年齡
能用 How many…? 詢問並說出物品的數量

sentences.en: Today is Tom's birthday. He is thirteen years old.
sentences.zh: 今天是湯姆的生日。他十三歲。

sentences.en: His mother bought twenty cupcakes for the party.
sentences.zh: 他媽媽為派對買了二十個杯子蛋糕。

sentences.en: "How many friends will come?" Tom asks.
"Fifteen students from your class," his mother says.
sentences.zh: 「你班上的十五個同學，」他媽媽說。

sentences.en: Tom's grandmother gave him thirty dollars as a gift.
sentences.zh: 湯姆的奶奶送他三十元作為禮物。

sentences.en: His uncle brought fifty balloons and one hundred candles.
sentences.zh: 他叔叔帶來了五十個氣球和一百根蠟燭。

sentences.en: "Wow! This is the best party ever!" Tom is so happy.
sentences.zh: 「哇！這是有史以來最棒的派對！」湯姆非常開心。

sentences.en: All the children sang and danced until ninety minutes had passed.
sentences.zh: 所有孩子又唱又跳，直到九十分鐘過去了。

sentences.en: Tom counted the gifts: there were nineteen presents in total.
sentences.zh: 湯姆數了數禮物：總共有十九份禮物。

sentences.en: "I will never forget this day," Tom said with a big smile.
sentences.zh: 「我永遠不會忘記今天，」湯姆帶著大大的笑容說。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① How old are you? 詢問年齡
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用來問別人的歲數，回答使用基數詞＋years old。
table: How old are you? I am twelve years old.
How old is your brother? He is fifteen years old.
How old are your friends? They are thirteen years old.

grammar_points.title_zh: ② How many...? 詢問數量
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用來問可數名詞的數量，回答使用基數詞＋名詞複數。

examples.en: How many apples do you have?
How many students are in the class?
How many books are on the shelf?

lines.en: I am eleven years old. How old are you?
I am twelve. How many brothers do you have?
lines.zh: 安娜：我十二歲。你有幾個兄弟？

lines.en: I have one brother. How many sisters do you have?
lines.zh: 湯姆：我有一個兄弟。你有幾個姐妹？

lines.en: I have two sisters. How many pencils are in your bag?
lines.zh: 安娜：我有兩個姐妹。你書包裡有多少支鉛筆？

sentences.en: How old are you? I am thirteen years old.
How old is your teacher? She is thirty years old.
sentences.zh: 你的老師幾歲？她三十歲。

sentences.en: How many chairs are there in the classroom? There are forty chairs.
sentences.zh: 教室裡有多少把椅子？有四十把椅子。

sentences.en: How many days are in a week? There are seven days.
How old are your grandparents? They are seventy years old.
sentences.zh: 你的祖父母幾歲？他們七十歲。

sentences.en: How many students like English? Twenty students like English.
sentences.zh: 有多少學生喜歡英語？二十個學生喜歡英語。

sentences.en: How old will you be next year? I will be fourteen years old.
sentences.zh: 明年你會多大？我將會十四歲。

sentences.en: How many books do you read each month? I read five books each month.
sentences.zh: 你每月讀多少本書？我每月讀五本書。

fill.q: I am ____ years old.（我十五歲。）
She is ____. She is thirteen.（她是。她十三歲。）
How many ____ do you have?（你有多少隻貓？）
I have twenty ____.（我有二十個蘋果。）
My friend is ____. He is nineteen years old.（我的朋友是。他十九歲。）
There are thirty ____ in this class.（這個班級有三十個學生。）
He has ____ brothers.（他有十一個兄弟。）
How many ____ are there?（有多少隻狗？）
I am ____. I am a student.（我十七歲。我是學生。）
